entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever! I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yes, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly, the heart rate monitor is completely off.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?

Thank you. Just one moment while I pull that up. Okay, I see your order here. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on the 1st. Today is the 16th. I'm so sorry you are not satisfied with your purchase.
Exactly! It's faulty! I want my money back.
I understand. Our standard return window is 10 days from the date of purchase. Unfortunately, it appears you are outside of that return window.

What?! Seriously? I just got this thing! Are you kidding me? It's practically brand new! Ten days? That's ridiculous! This VeloBand Pulse is defective! I want a refund! I've always shopped with you and you can't even offer me a refund?!

I understand your frustration. While I can't offer a full refund outside of the return window, let's see what options we have. While a refund is not possible at this time, I would like to offer you store credit. We value your business with VeloFit.
Store credit? I guess that's better than nothing. I was really hoping for a refund, though.

I understand, and I apologize for the inconvenience. I did check to see if a policy exception could be made in this instance, given the issue you're experiencing with the VeloBand Pulse, but it is not possible. However, with the store credit, you can choose another product that might suit you better.
Okay, fine. What's the process for the store credit?

Great! I've already issued a store credit to your account for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. You can use it immediately on our website or at any of our retail locations. You will receive an email with the details of the credit, including the amount and any expiration date, within the hour.
Okay, I see it now. Thanks.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for your help!
Have a great day with VeloFit!
